originalLicenseNote: Engine source under GPL-3.0; embeds the network 0178r.bin from https://github.com/Yoshie2000/PlentyNetworks (GPL-3.0).
blurb: PlentyChess 8.0.0 is the June 2026 release of Yoshie2000's GPL C++ UCI chess engine, developed with OpenBench testing on furybench and trained with bullet. It pairs singular, double and triple extensions with multi-cut, ProbCut, razoring, reverse futility, null-move, late-move, futility and SEE pruning, upcoming-repetition detection, and continuation histories with pawn, non-pawn and continuation correction histories with an embedded NNUE of threat, pawn-pair and 12 king-bucketed piece-square inputs, a 640-wide accumulator, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper, its SSSE3 net code compiled to WebAssembly SIMD through SIMDe.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build on the C poll helper, with the worker's search run on the UCI thread and Threads fixed to 1; built by hand with the flags of the Makefile's ssse3 architecture, with the net laid out by the engine's own tool for that path; the SSSE3 path compiled through SIMDe to 128-bit WebAssembly SIMD, with node counts equal to the native AVX2 build's and to the release's bench; no Syzygy tablebases; Hash capped at 1024 MB.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Principal variation search with iterative deepening, MultiPV and aspiration windows.

features.label: Mate Distance Pruning
features.implementation: Alpha and beta bounded by the mate distance from the root.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification when the eval is far below alpha.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Capture search against a raised beta, guided by the hash entry.

features.label: Internal Iterative Reductions
features.implementation: One ply less without a hash move.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Singular, double and triple extensions, with multi-cut and negative extensions.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Reductions adjusted by history, node type and correction.

features.label: Late-Move, Futility & SEE Pruning
features.implementation: Late-move, history, futility and SEE pruning in the moves loop.

features.label: Histories & Correction
features.implementation: Quiet, capture and continuation histories with killer and counter moves, plus pawn, non-pawn and continuation correction histories.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Clustered hash table, cleared at a new game.

features.label: NNUE
features.implementation: Embedded integer net: threat, pawn-pair and 12 king-bucketed piece-square inputs, a 640-wide accumulator, then 16, 32 and 1 in 8 output buckets.
